desc:
Vocaloid Tower Defense

Lead your Vocaloid team in this co op tower defense! Build a loadout, place and upgrade towers, and survive encores, challenges, raids, and events.

✦ 24 Playable Towers - Miku, Teto, Luka, Kaito, Meiko, Neru, SeeU, Mayu, Kagamine Duo, Yukari, Lapis, Gumi, Macne, Stardust, CUL, Lily, TT-chan, IA, Adachi Rei, Luo Tianyi, Gakupo, Defoko, V Flower, and Haku.

✦ Solo or Co op - Up to 4 Producers or 8 in Octet.

✦ Challenge Battles - Beat IA, Luo Tianyi, Lily, Adachi Rei, Gakupo, and Eternal to unlock exclusive towers.

✦ Melody Reverie - A roguelike run through every encore.

✦ Tower Battles - PvP against other Producers.

✦ Modules - Evolve your Vocaloids into forms like Exorcist Miku and Matriarch Gumi.

✦ Collect & Customize - Skins themes emotes and songs.
